verdict.rationale: Inngest documents step.ai.wrap(), which wraps the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDKs as durable steps, and ships its own AgentKit agent framework. Its durable-agent docs say every step and tool call is checkpointed and resumes after a crash, and it captures gen_ai.* telemetry from AI calls. Missing for 10: wrappers for third-party agent frameworks (only first-party AgentKit is shown), breadth of model-provider coverage beyond the three named SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these wrappers remove glue code.
